en: Black-and-white interior view of an early 20th‑century café or Gasthaus with wooden chairs and tables covered in lace tablecloths, floral centerpieces, arched doorways, a bar or counter with display cabinets, wall clock, and decorative geometric ceiling. Small wall posters and a stove are visible. The lower margin of the image bears handwritten-style captions, likely the place name and establishment name.
